parsed.explanation: This is a thin-data totalitarian jurisdiction: no rule of law, no civil society, no LGBT organisation possible, and official hostility documented (2014 slur, denial of existence, forced concealment, 2024 tightening laws). No trans-specific statute is documented, but Articles 193/262 are undefined and enforcement sits wholly at official discretion in a regime with no independent courts — any discretionary law here is effectively enforceable with no recourse. Extrapolating structurally: gender-nonconforming presentation would be treated as a moral/political matter at state discretion, with dated defector accounts (2011, 2014) alleging executions for homosexuality and a documented culture of forced total concealment. Detention, stranding, and severe mistreatment on outing face no remedy. Not documented near-certain execution, so not 0.05, but structural severity plus zero recourse places this firmly in the severe-risk band near its bottom.
